name: NASA Earthdata / CMR
desc: Search Earth-observation collections and granules; selected assets may require Earthdata Login.
access: Public catalogue metadata; many downloads are open, while restricted collections require sign-in.

name: NASA Planetary Data System
desc: Search planetary mission archives and validate PDS3/PDS4 products with official tooling.
access: Archive products generally public; cite mission-specific terms and labels.

name: NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive
desc: NASA's permanent archive for space science mission data and mission records.
access: Product-specific availability and access instructions apply.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
desc: Discover Sentinel Earth-observation collections through the public STAC catalogue; item assets may have product access constraints.
access: Catalogue discovery is public; product downloads, quotas and authentication depend on service.

name: EUMETSAT Data Store
desc: Meteorological satellite products, collection browsing, API tooling and bulk data access.
access: Search/browse APIs exist; account/token requirements vary by product and download method.

name: ISRO / NRSC Bhoonidhi
desc: Satellite data search and download for Indian and selected international Earth-observation missions.
access: API access requires registered credentials; this site intentionally does not collect or store the credentials.

name: ISRO / NRSC Bhuvan
desc: Indian geospatial visualisation and thematic mapping services.
access: Service-specific terms, layers and access options vary.

name: ISRO MOSDAC
desc: Meteorological and oceanographic satellite data and products.
access: Some services require user registration.

name: JAXA DARTS
desc: Science archives spanning astronomy, solar-terrestrial physics and planetary exploration; provides format-specific guidance.
access: Many datasets offer direct public downloads; follow individual mission instructions.

name: Chinese National Space Science Data Center (NSSDC)
desc: Space physics, space astronomy, lunar and planetary science resources including Chang'e, Tianwen and science mission datasets.
access: Dataset permissions and download methods vary; some data require researcher authorization.

name: China NSSDC Data Access
desc: National Space Science Data Center resources, scientific archives and dataset access interfaces.
access: Some research datasets are access-controlled or require PI permission.

name: China National Space Administration — Resources
desc: CNSA resource services linking lunar exploration data, national remote-sensing data and satellite query services.
access: The linked data services have their own access and reuse rules.

name: Chinese Lunar Exploration Data Release System
desc: Officially referenced lunar exploration data platform; consult mission product standards and labels.
access: Verify the currently accessible endpoint, data licensing and mission product standard before bulk fetching.

name: Roscosmos
desc: Official Russian state space corporation portal. This registry does not assert an open, general-purpose public data API; use mission/archive links published by the agency.
access: Public download APIs and reuse terms are mission-dependent; do not assume unrestricted bulk access.

name: Russian Earth-observation data access
desc: Use only the acquisition/data-distribution service named by a Russian mission or data provider. Do not treat third-party imagery portals as Roscosmos APIs.
access: No universal Roscosmos browser API is advertised here; check access, license, and sanctions/export-control requirements.

name: Natural Resources Canada EODMS
desc: Earth observation data management and discovery for Canadian and international satellite data collections.
access: Accounts and provider-specific permissions may be required.

name: NOAA CLASS
desc: Comprehensive Large Array-data Stewardship System for NOAA environmental satellite data.
access: Dataset and account conditions vary.

name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
desc: Environmental and satellite datasets, metadata services and APIs.
access: Public datasets subject to dataset-specific terms.

name: Korea Aerospace Administration / KARI ecosystem
desc: Official Korean space programme entry points and mission information; satellite data access depends on mission and distribution service.
access: Use the official mission or imagery distribution portal where provided.

name: UK space-science and Earth-observation archives
desc: The UK contributes to mission science through research institutes and national Earth-observation services; no single universal UKSA file API is implied.
access: Choose the archive responsible for a given instrument or mission.

name: ESA Planetary Science Archive
desc: ESA's repository for planetary mission science products, with PDS-based and mission-specific products.
access: Use product-specific labels, ancillary files and archive instructions.

name: ESA Science Archives
desc: Astronomy and science mission archive access for ESA missions.
access: Individual archives document account requirements and downloads.

name: International standards & shared archives
desc: Cross-country space packet standards and shared data exchange models.
access: Standards documentation may have usage terms; implementation code licensing is separate.
